$comment: Sodwana bathymetry project hooks. Intent: (a) instant syntax/JSON gate on every pipeline or geojson edit; (b) auto-run quick validation whenever model/fusion scripts run; (c) BLOCK git push unless full validation + site smoke test pass (the deployment gate). Hook input arrives as JSON on stdin (tool_input.file_path / tool_input.command).

hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *pipeline/*.py) python -m py_compile "$f" || exit 2;; *.geojson) python -c "import json,sys;json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))" "$f" || exit 2;; *.json) python -c "import json,sys;json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))" "$f" || exit 2;; esac
c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); echo "$c" | grep -qE 'pipeline/0[45]' && python pipeline/validate.py --quick || true

c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$c" | grep -q 'git push'; then python pipeline/validate.py && python pipeline/smoke_site.py || { echo 'PUSH BLOCKED: validation or site smoke test failed' >&2; exit 2; }; fi
echo "- [session $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%MZ)] review pipeline output; append real discoveries here." >> CLAUDE.md
